column1: # CAS Type Classification Rules (Extracted from XML definitions - MacSyFinder compatible)
# mandatory: Type-defining genes that MUST be present (at least min_mandatory of them)
# accessory: Optional genes that support classification (cas1/2/4 adaptation + others)
# db_count:  Number of verified instances in CRISPRCasDB (used as log-prior in type scoring)
# ANY mandatory OR accessory gene can START a cassette!
